h: Fubara reportedly asks supporters to stop calling him their leader and to look to Wike instead
p: Rivers State Governor Siminalayi Fubara has reportedly asked his supporters to stop describing him as their leader and to regard FCT Minister Nyesom Wike as their common leader. The remark is said to have drawn mixed reactions in the state's political circles.
more: The two men have been at odds over control of Rivers politics in recent years.
Supporters of both sides are said to be reading the remark differently.
Neither camp has issued a longer statement so far.
